app.name: NINJA SAMURAI WORKOUT: GHOST
title.lead: Stand your phone up so it sees your whole body. Every swing you make is scored by the camera. Cuts are judged against the forms you register, and their power comes from your weapon's weight and your hand speed.
title.formnote: You have not registered any forms yet, so swings are judged against standard values. Register your own ideal swings under Register forms for steadier judging.
mode.adv.desc: Slay yokai to level up, collect gear, and turn defeated yokai into shikigami. Dodge enemy attacks by crouching, guarding or stepping aside.
mode.musha.desc: No levels, gear, shikigami or enemy attacks. Pour pure swing power into a straw target for 60 seconds. Personal bests are kept per judging level and weight class.
menu.forms.desc: Record your ideal swing for all 9 forms
setup.diff.label: Judging level (your training rank)
setup.diff.note: Higher levels multiply damage and EXP. At every level, swings are compared with the speed, direction, reach, wobble and slow-down of your registered forms.
setup.slots.label: Register up to 3 weapons (tap to switch during a fight)
setup.slot.name: Weapon {n} name
setup.height.note: Used to turn the camera's 3D estimate into real speed (m/s).
setup.atk.note: If you fail to dodge, the yokai heals and your COMBO ends.
setup.stats.label: Your current weapon
setup.safety: Never use a real blade. Use training gear such as a practice bokuto, a steel-core bokuto or a macebell. Keep more than arm-plus-weapon length clear in every direction, away from people, furniture and lights.
diff.0.name: NYUMON
diff.0.desc: Counts a swing even if it is a little slow or shaky
diff.1.name: SHODAN
diff.1.desc: Ignores hand waving and the sword coming back
diff.2.name: SANDAN
diff.2.desc: Needs the direction and speed of the form
diff.3.name: SHIHAN
diff.3.desc: Allows almost no wobble or slow-down
diff.4.name: SHIN'IKI
diff.4.desc: Only a flawless, god-like swing counts
type.shinmen.hint: From straight above to straight down
type.kiriage.hint: From straight below to straight up
type.kesa.hint: From upper right to lower left
type.gyakukesa.hint: From upper left to lower right
type.kesaage.hint: From lower left to upper right
type.gyakukesaage.hint: From lower right to upper left
forms.lead: Swing your ideal cut three times for each form to register it. From then on, swings are judged against it for speed, direction, reach, wobble and slow-down. Unregistered forms use standard values. Left and right are as you see yourself in the mirrored camera image.
forms.saved: Registered · {peak} m/s ({kg} kg) · reach {amp} m · wobble {wob}
gear.total.label: Total bonus from gear and your shikigami
gear.owned.label: Your gear
gear.note: Gear drops when you slay yokai. Grades run NAMI, RYO, WAZAMONO, O-WAZAMONO and SAIJO O-WAZAMONO. Above 40 pieces, the lowest-grade gear you are not wearing is released automatically.
gear.empty: No gear yet. Slay yokai in Yokai Hunt to find some.
item.name: {pre} {slot}
item.title: {rarity} · {name}
book.note: Slain yokai sometimes become your shikigami. Golden yokai are rare, with more HP and EXP, and become shikigami more easily. Taming the same yokai again deepens your bond (★). The blessing of the one shikigami you bring along works in battle.
partner.kappa: Enemy healing when you are hit -50%

skill.rengeki.name: RENGEKI
skill.kaishin.name: KAISHIN
skill.zanshin.name: ZANSHIN
skill.onikiri.name: ONIKIRI
map.title: Hunt log
map.note: Yokai HP slowly recovers over time and is full again 24 hours after it last took damage. If you cannot finish one, retreat and come back before it recovers.
map.locked: Appears after you slay the previous yokai
battle.place1:
Stand your phone upright, step back 2–3 m
and make sure you are visible from head to feet.
battle.place2: Facing the camera gives the steadiest tracking.
battle.demo.tip: Try it without a camera (Space also works)
battle.gestureHelp: Hands-free: cross your forearms in front of your chest for 2 seconds to retreat. On the result screen, raise both hands above your head for 1 second for the next yokai, or cross your forearms to return to the hunt log.
test.label: For testing:
toast.noSwitchMusha: You cannot switch weapons during a Musha Shugyo run
toast.gold: A golden {name} appeared! More HP and EXP, and easier to tame
musha.intro:
Compete on pure swing power for 60 seconds.
Pick your weapon; the clock starts with your first swing.
gesture.okHint: Raise both hands above your head for 1s
gesture.ngHint: Cross your forearms in front of your chest for 1s
cam.unsupported: This browser cannot use the camera. Open the page over https in Chrome or Safari on your phone. You can still try the flow with Test swing.
cam.denied: Could not use the camera ({err}). Check the camera permission. Meanwhile you can try the flow with Test swing.
cam.loading: Loading the pose model (a few seconds the first time)…
cam.modelFail: Could not load the pose model. Reopen the page while online.
cam.ready: Stand where you are visible from head to feet, take your stance and swing. If a swing is not counted, the reason shows at the top left.
